'''Pinky''' is a small enemy primarily found in {{ch|The Alley}}. 

== Behavior ==
* Moves to random tiles every turn.
* Attacks an enemy, if it moves next to one.
=== Tips ===

== Summoning ==
Can be summoned as a familiar through several means:
* Items:
** {{i|Rat Hat}}
** {{i|Rat Mask}}
** {{i|Rat Necklace}}
* Events:
** {{event|Fetus}}, Good rare outcome of the Charm option.
** {{event|Mouse nest}}, Good common outcome of the Charm option.

== Trivia ==
* Colloquially, a [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/pinky pinky] is a newborn rat or mouse.
* If a Pinky corpse is spawned via the {{event|Mouse Nest}}, it will have the unique description "This poor little guy didn't stand a chance!".
